title: Considering promises and feeling fairness

captions.physics: Matching expectations to words actually spoken
captions.emotions: Feeling fairness in an accepted condition

meaning: You can find a fair measure in a shared promise by distinguishing spoken words from expectations and understanding its personal meaning for both people.
text: An honest reply is not always found in the most obvious formula. Justice in the physical position of Vishuddha matches expectation to what was actually said. The Hermit in energy helps understand shared words’ personal meaning. Justice in emotions gives a sense of fair proportion. The repeated card distinguishes action from experience: precision can lead to feeling that a condition suits both. Honesty can include different amounts of participation beyond requiring closeness to prove itself continually through equal returned favours.

For example, you discuss “Our help is mutual”. Questions reveal one person’s need to receive a response and another’s difficulty promising equivalent time. **A fair measure can be more personal than equal accounting.** Actual readiness can be named alongside appreciation for what was given. Consent need not compare every minute. Gratitude, a present request and an accepted promise stay distinct beyond one silent debt supposedly repaid identically in form and extent.

The difficulty is checking fairness through every separate occasion after understanding is found. A small mismatch seems to prove the arrangement ineffective. Returning to the actual request preserves depth. A sufficiently honest promise can consider different possibilities when both hear terms and answer freely now instead of defending their entire history of participation.
